Build-only installer executes the active Python interpreter with fixed pip subcommands and argument arrays, shell=False. Source downloads are hash-required, extraction uses the data filter, native build paths are stable below root-owned /opt, and the build directory is removed after installation.

Release tool uses argument arrays and shell=False. Executables are fixed git/Python/skopeo commands; source policies and version/asset destinations are validated before publication. Operator/CI PATH and tool installation remain trusted environment inputs, not network-controlled commands. Tests cover malformed metadata and unverified publication rejection.

D-Bus credential lookup may fail for vanished callers or denied bus policy. The fallback explicitly records credentials_status=unavailable and does not invent an authenticated identity. Capture is observational, not an authorization gateway.
Internal method-dispatch invariant and type narrowing: capture is initialized before scheduling this task. It is not an authorization or input-validation check; disabling asserts cannot grant access.

follow_up: The new B108 fixed-/tmp warning was resolved by moving build staging below root-owned /opt; no rule suppression was added.
